differences.aspect: hidden random source and repeated object calls
differences.native: LeetCode constructs Solution(rects); each pick() call obtains a hidden randrange(total) ticket.
differences.app: solve receives rects plus an authored random_values stream and draws count, derives each deterministic randrange(total) ticket, and invokes the same pick calculation for every requested result.
differences.rationale: An offline deterministic judge must expose random inputs and a finite call count. Prefix construction, weighted ticket lookup, rectangle offset decoding, and per-pick logarithmic complexity are identical after the random-source adapter.
